title: Oracle HCM Cloud Consultant
summary: Configures Oracle Fusion HCM Cloud, Oracle's online HR software, for clients: core employee records, leave (Absence), payroll and talent processes, plus fast formulas (small rules written in Oracle's formula language), bulk data loads and reports. Sits in an Oracle implementation or support team between client HR teams and technical developers.
dailyDuties: Run design workshops and fit-gap sessions with HR teams
Configure Core HR, Absence or Payroll setups in the cloud tenant
Write and fix fast formulas for accruals, eligibility and validation
Prepare and load HDL files for workers and setup data
Build OTBI analyses for HR users
Test quarterly updates and support user acceptance testing

skills.expectation: Configure at least two Oracle HCM Cloud modules such as Core HR, Absence, Payroll or Talent
Work in Oracle Fusion Cloud setup tasks, security roles and quarterly updates
Write and fix fast formulas for absence accruals, eligibility, validation or payroll
Load and correct worker and setup data with HDL and HSDL
Build OTBI analyses and simple BI Publisher reports for HR users
Run design workshops and fit-gap sessions with HR teams
Write test scripts and lead user acceptance testing and go-live support
Explain configuration choices and issues clearly to HR users
Work with client HR, payroll and IT leads across phases
Understand OIC integrations that feed or read HCM data
Write SQL for BI Publisher data models and data checks
Write configuration workbooks and design documents
